versionCode: 141

### Whats New (09-29-25 Build)

  - nightly.sh: bump character limit to 4500. i will never hit that... (hopefully)
  - bump versionCode
  - news and updates adapter: prevent some null scenarios that could result in a crash
  - Update NewsUpdateAdapter.java
  - Update nightly.sh
  - format code
  - news and updates: redesign shimmer to match article adapter layout for a streamlined user experience
  - Update NewsUpdateAdapter.java
  - News and Updates Adapter: NEW: add animations on initial load, and a separate animation on scroll, optimize code
  - news and updater adapter: greatly improve palette colors for the article images and other misc. improvements

  - news and updates: reduce text size with the article image being smaller
  - bump versionCode

  - Update nightly.sh
  - bump versionCode

  - Update nightly.sh

  - build.gradle: update 6 libraries
  - Update nightly.sh
  - changelog xml: fix changelog body margins

  - Changelog Activity and XML: attempt to fix text cutoff for large parsed changelogs
  - build.gradle / nightly.sh: bump default versionCode and versionName

  - news and updates xml: improve date (increase text size, fix margins and paddings)
  - Update NewsUpdateAdapter.java
  - News and Updates adapter: improve logic on when to apply black text or white for the dynamic date background text, punch date text opacity up
  - improve README.md
  - news and updates list: adjust margins, remove cardview elevation, adjust text size for title
  - News and Updates Adapter: improve code structure and code comments
  - News and Updates UI improvement: add a colored background with dynamic palette colors behind news and updates text
  - NewsUpdatesAdapter.java: add slight transparency to dynamic palette background pill
